hooks.name: Record Kiro evidence after each spec task
hooks.description: Keeps the Kiro usage evidence log current for the hackathon write-up.

action.prompt: A spec task just completed. Append a concise entry to docs/kiro-log.md with: date, task id and title, which Kiro features were used (spec, steering, hook, MCP, agent, powers, PBT, IDE/CLI/Crew), what was produced, and any surprise or lesson. Keep it factual and in English. Do not change anything else.
